sp.title: Seasonal pages
sp.sub: Permanent pages for Eid, winter, Puja and your own occasions. Kept for good and used again each year.
sp.off: Seasonal pages are off: the shop shows none of them yet. Switch them on in the card below when a page is ready.

kpi.restingFoot: were live, now taken down: the link still opens

sp.emptySub: Make one page for each occasion (for example Eid). Next year you change its words and products and make it live again: the link stays the same.

card.d: Whether the shop shows the live seasonal pages, the occasions, and how many products and guides a page shows.
card.on: Show the live seasonal pages in the shop
card.offSeason: Keep the link when a page is taken down
card.offSeasonHelp: A page that was live once still opens and says it comes back for its occasion, so its link never breaks.
card.articlesMax: Most journal guides on a page
card.cutoff: Show the Eid order-by line (Rules › Eid) on these occasions
card.occasionsHelp: The key is a short link word (small letters, digits, hyphens). The names show on the page.
card.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.

err.STALE: Someone changed these settings a moment ago. They are shown again; make your change once more.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not right. Check the numbers and the occasions (each key once, small letters).
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.

b.headline: Headline
b.linkHelp: The page opens at {domain}/collections/{slug}. Keep the same link every year.
b.partsSub: The order is fixed. Switch each part on or off.
b.picksSub: The products come from a collection, the guides from a journal category. Prices are always the products' own.
b.collectionHelp: Make a seasonal collection in Products › Collections. Its own start and end dates decide when its products show.
b.categoryHelp: The newest live articles of this category show, in the page's language, while the journal is on.
b.wordsSub: Your own line under the headline, the reasons (one per line) and when the countdown ends.
b.reasonsBn: Reasons in Bengali, one per line
b.timerHelp: The countdown hides itself after this time.
b.cutoffHelp: The order-by line shows only for the occasions ticked in the settings card, and only while Rules › Eid is on.
b.publishConfirm: Tap again to make it live
b.readOnly: You can see this page but not change it.
b.reuse: Used again each year: change the words and products, then make it live again. The link stays the same.

err.STALE: Someone changed this page a moment ago. It is shown again; make your change once more.
err.SLUG_TAKEN: This link is already used by a category, the New in page or another seasonal page. Pick another.
err.NOT_READY: Before it goes live, pick {fields}, or switch that part off.
err.WRONG_STATE: This step does not fit the page's state now.
err.ARCHIVED: An archived page cannot be changed. Restore it first.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in ended. Sign in again.
